gripOrHq.title: Social Engineering
gripOrHq.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Invisibility
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. For each card stored in HQ, the Corp either pays [2] or discards that card.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

scoreArea.title: Encryption Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

scoreArea.title: Political Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Invisibility

rig.title: Cloak
rig.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Elena Laskova
rig.rulesText: Whenever you play a prep, gain an additional [1] the first time you gain bits from its effect. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: Chiba Bank Account
rig.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

root.title: Holovid Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Holovid Campaign when you rez it. Take [1] from Holovid Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Holovid Campaign.

[Subroutine] End the run.
